anchor.exact: The suffix -e is originally a possessive suffix of the noun, but here it serves to add a possessor as the subject.

statement.en: In the possessor-requiring intransitive subject incorporation construction ku-tek-e-pase 'I feel as if I had aged' (lit. 'I am my-hands-heavy'), the suffix -e originally marks nominal possession but functions to add the possessor as the clausal subject.
statement.ja: 所属形を要する自動詞主語抱合構文 ku-tek-e-pase「私の手が重い（＝年をとった気がする）」において、接尾辞 -e は本来名詞の所属形接尾辞であるが、ここでは所有者を文の主語として加える機能を果たしている。

anchor.exact: Here, koy ‘wave’ can, in fact, be interpreted as the object, so this type of NI is structurally ambiguous, though the context usually helps to choose the right interpretation.

statement.en: Transitive subject noun incorporation clauses like ku-koy-yanke are structurally ambiguous because the incorporated noun can also be interpreted as the direct object.
statement.ja: ku-koy-yanke のような他動詞主語名詞抱合節は、抱合名詞が直接目的語としても解釈されうるため構造的に多義である。

anchor.exact: The possessor of the incorporated noun is always co-referential with the subject, that is, the interpretation of the possessor is always reflexive.

statement.en: In intransitive possessor-requiring subject incorporation, the possessor of the incorporated noun is always interpreted reflexively as co-referential with the clause subject.
statement.ja: 所属形を要する自動詞主語抱合において、抱合名詞の所有者は常に主語と同一指示的であり再帰的に解釈される。

entailment.quote: The possessor of the incorporated noun is always co-referential with the subject, that is, the interpretation of the possessor is always reflexive.

anchor.exact: The possessor is unmarked, but it is automatically interpreted as reflexive (= co-referential with the subject). So, the reference of ‘self’ changes according to the subject.

statement.en: In intransitive possessor-requiring subject incorporation, the possessor itself is unmarked on the incorporated noun and is interpreted reflexively according to the clausal subject.
statement.ja: 所属形を要する自動詞主語抱合において、抱合名詞上で所有者自体は無標識であり、文の主語に応じて自動的に再帰的に解釈される。

entailment.quote: The possessor is unmarked, but it is automatically interpreted as reflexive (= co-referential with the subject).
